success_definition: pelvis z > 0.70 m and torso tilt < 15 deg in 50 consecutive policy-step samples (0.02 s apart, i.e. held for 1 s); time-to-stand = time of the FIRST sample of the first such run (state at t = (index + 1) * dt, t = 0 is the reset state)

obs_term_what_is_tested.base_lin_vel: native velocimeter sensor recomputed by mj_forward from the copied qpos/qvel
obs_term_what_is_tested.base_ang_vel: native gyro sensor recomputed by mj_forward from the copied qpos/qvel
obs_term_what_is_tested.projected_gravity: native pelvis rotation (mj_kinematics) from the copied qpos
obs_term_what_is_tested.joint_pos: copied qpos -> joint order (name lookup) minus default_joint_pos from getup_info.json
obs_term_what_is_tested.joint_vel: copied qvel -> joint order only (no arithmetic, so exact 0 means the index mapping is right; it cannot detect a velocity-estimation problem)
obs_term_what_is_tested.actions: native-maintained last raw action (zeros at reset) vs mjlab's last_action term
obs_term_what_is_tested.command: native constant zero vs mjlab's generated_commands(twist); trivial: the command is identically zero in this task (see mjlab_command_max_abs)

physics_difference_diagnostic.what: single physics substep, same state + qacc_warmstart + ctrl written into mujoco_warp (mjlab) and native MuJoCo; max |qvel diff| (rad/s or m/s) per env, 8 envs (2 per fallen pose), seed 0

actuator_saturation_diagnostic.what: actuator saturation x implicitfast velocity derivative; seed 0, 128 envs (pose = env % 4, push level = [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0][env // 32]), push at policy step 200 (t = 4 s): joint pos U(+-0.3) rad (clipped to range - 0.02), root lin vel U(+-1) m/s, root ang vel U(+-2) rad/s, joint vel N(0, 1.5) rad/s, each times the push level
actuator_saturation_diagnostic.warp_source: mujoco_warp 3.5.0 _src/derivative.py _qderiv_actuator_passive_vel: vel = biasprm[2] (+ gain terms) for every actuator, actuator_forcelimited is not read
actuator_saturation_diagnostic.outcome_definitions: recovered = pelvis z > 0.70 m and torso tilt < 15 deg in each of the last 50 policy steps (last 1 s of the 10 s episode); fell = pelvis z < 0.5 m at any time after the push; lost_ok = the stand condition failed at least once after the push

saturation_by_phase_native.what: Which actuators are force-saturated in the native get-up closed loop (out/getup_native.npz), by phase?
